questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound is a mechanical wave and needs a medium to travel. It cannot travel through vacuum.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The device used to measure electric current is:
questions.explanation: An Ammeter is used to measure electric current. It is connected in series in a circuit.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which of the following is a renewable source of energy?
questions.explanation: Solar energy is renewable as the Sun continuously provides it. Coal, petroleum, and natural gas are non-renewable fossil fuels.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A mirror that always forms a virtual image is:
questions.explanation: Both convex mirror and plane mirror always form virtual images. Concave mirror can form both real and virtual images.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The pH of a neutral solution is:
questions.explanation: A neutral solution has pH = 7. Acidic < 7, Basic > 7.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Diamond is an allotrope of:
questions.explanation: Diamond is an allotrope of Carbon, where each carbon atom is sp³ hybridized in a tetrahedral arrangement.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The chemical formula of common salt is:
questions.explanation: Common salt (table salt) is Sodium Chloride, NaCl.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Acids taste:
questions.explanation: Acids taste sour (e.g., lemon contains citric acid). Bases taste bitter.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the next number in the sequence 2, 4, 6, 8, __?
questions.explanation: The sequence is even numbers (common difference 2). Next: 8 + 2 = 10.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.explanation: A hexagon has 6 sides. Pentagon = 5, Heptagon = 7, Octagon = 8.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The basic unit of life is:
questions.explanation: The Cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life. All living organisms are made up of cells.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Bones are joined to muscles by:
questions.explanation: Tendons connect muscles to bones. Ligaments connect bones to bones.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts water from roots to leaves?
questions.explanation: Xylem transports water and minerals upward (roots to leaves). Phloem transports food (leaves to other parts).

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The process of cell division in somatic cells is called:
questions.explanation: Mitosis is the type of cell division in somatic (body) cells, producing two identical daughter cells.
